run_by: the author; the repository lists are withheld so as not to name other people's projects
checks: the two README checks (readme-claim-mismatch, score-without-result) at commit 45f0718 on the feat/claims branch, run with the .scanignore and scan-limit behaviour of the commit before it

tuning_sample.description: the 50 repositories of the 2 November run; the checks were tuned on their statements

fresh_sample.description: 50 other repositories chosen by the same rule; nothing was tuned on them

flags_ruled.unit: one flag; the score-without-result flag covers 2 README lines and the readme-claim-mismatch flag covers 1 README line, so 3 lines in 2 flags
flags_ruled.ruled_by: the seat's AI agent, which did not build the checks

reading: Fewer than 5 decided statements for every kind of README claim, so no rate is stated and both checks report at information. Recall was not measured.
